name: codex-memory-hub
description: Codex memory plugin for clean, restartable, parallel project work with automatic memory intent detection and cross-platform deterministic maintenance.

interface.shortDescription: Automatic thread memory for Codex project work.
interface.longDescription: Initializes a clean Codex memory layout for Windows, macOS, and Linux. The project root keeps only AGENTS.md while all memory data lives under .codex-memory with per-thread logs, continues_from handoff links, automatic workstream inference, archive folders, generated system indexes, legacy docs/wiki migration, cross-platform doctor/index maintenance, and safe local Git defaults.
defaultPrompt: Initialize Codex Memory Hub for this project.
Use project memory for this task, create a new thread when needed, and infer the right context automatically.
